description: This file defines the TempNameExpression class in the Twig templating engine. It manages temporary variable names within the Twig AST, handling name validation, deprecation warnings, and compilation of variable references.

classes.name: TempNameExpression
classes.description: Represents a temporary name expression node in Twig's AST, handling validation, deprecation, and code generation for variable names within templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TempNameExpression instance, validating the name, issuing deprecation warnings, and converting numeric names.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to output the variable name during template compilation.
